title: Spiral light, Earth Energy flux and Polarity of Life Form
path: RS2-1: The inanimate, physics, chemistry, astronomy

posts.content:
The intelligent infinity, the star of all, is indeed the unity in RS. I think there's a gap between Larson's unity and intelligent infinity which is the unit energy. Because of the Yin/Yang aspect of motion, when unity energy is tapped to create deviations, the unity also has its Yin/Yang aspect that represented as spiral energy by a spatial perspective. That would divide the energy of unit motion into two type of spiral, which is the left spiral and right spiral, none of these geometry would be exist if any deviation from unity is occurred. This kind of geometry is only perceived BY A SPATIAL PERSPECTIVE, while in time/space, it might be straight, or longitudinal wave form, I don't know. Unit motion does have no physical resultant, but it still has its function when deviation from unity occurred. The energy influx of Earth is a good example. Because Earth is a positively polarized planet, the energy influx of Earth South Pole is the unit motion, and energy higher than unit is flowing into the North Pole. These two spiral interacting with each other, forming a hierarchical structure which is the chakra of Earth. Then these hierarchical energies are influx into secondary geometry points of Earth, forming the so called Earth Grid. There are several major points of the grid, the great pyramid of Egypt for example. The spiral influx of these point are different between the North Hemisphere and the South Hemisphere. In the North Hemisphere, it is right spiral, the same spiral that of water vortex. These points of North Hemisphere is very suitable for a positive polarized entity to evolve and have more dense energies. Look at the map, you will find there's a major influx in China, Egypt, California of USA. Australia, has a major influx but more suitable for a negative entity.

A life form, like human, have the same energy influx polarities. Human is naturally born with a positive polarity, which is unit energy influx into the root Chakra and higher energy influx into the top. A secondary energy influx web system is the Chinese meridians system. These kind of energy flow is from the spiral light as Ra referred. Energy flow into our North Pole of Earth or a human looks like electron of positron in RS2 I think.

To keep health, one should retain the positive energy flow or positive polarity. Some sensitive people can tell the polarity of others. By the way, most types of Qi Gong in China are negative. The positive path would not absorb energies but let the energy flow through the body naturally and then it would be positively polarized.
